functions.name: make_circular_system
functions.body:
local function make_circular_system(n)
  local bodies = { Body:new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1000) }
  for i = 1, n do
    local r = 10 + i * 2
    local v = math.sqrt(1000 / r)
    local a = 2 * math.pi * i / n
    table.insert(bodies, Body:new(
      math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r, 0,
      -math.sin(a) * v, math.cos(a) * v, 0, 1))
  end
  return bodies
end
functions.developer_comment: Build n bodies on a circular orbit around a central mass of 1000.

functions.name: make_random_system
functions.body:
local function make_random_system(n, seed)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local bodies = {}
  for i = 1, n do
    table.insert(bodies, Body:new(
      math.random() * 20 - 10, math.random() * 20 - 10, math.random() * 20 - 10,
      math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1, math.random() * 0.2 - 0.1, 0,
      1 + math.random()))
  end
  return bodies
end
functions.developer_comment: Build n bodies at pseudo-random positions with small random velocities.

functions.name: tick
functions.body:
local function tick(sim, bodies, dt)
  local e = sim:total_energy(bodies)
  sim:accelerations(bodies)
  sim:step(bodies, dt)
  log.info("energy=" .. tostring(e))
end
functions.developer_comment: Advance one frame: compute total energy, then integrate the bodies.

functions.name: main
functions.body:
local function main()
  local bodies
  if MODE == "circular" then
    bodies = make_circular_system(8)
  else
    bodies = make_random_system(12, os.time())
  end

  local dt = 1 / FPS
  for _ = 1, RUNS do
    tick(NBody, bodies, dt)
  end

  return #bodies
end

functions.name: new
functions.body:
function Body:new(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz, mass)
  local self = setmetatable({}, { __index = Body })
  self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y, z
  self.vx, self.vy, self.vz = vx, vy, vz
  self.mass = mass
  self.ax, self.ay, self.az = 0, 0, 0
  return self
end
functions.developer_comment: Create a body at (x,y,z) with velocity (vx,vy,vz) and the given mass.

functions.name: reset
functions.body:
function Body:reset(x, y, z, vx, vy, vz)
  self.x, self.y, self.z = x, y, z
  self.vx, self.vy, self.vz = vx, vy, vz
  self.ax, self.ay, self.az = 0, 0, 0
end
functions.developer_comment: Reset the body state, keeping the same table instance.

functions.name: apply_force
functions.body:
function Body:apply_force(fx, fy, fz, dt)
  self.vx = self.vx + fx * dt / self.mass
  self.vy = self.vy + fy * dt / self.mass
  self.vz = self.vz + fz * dt / self.mass
end
functions.developer_comment: Apply a force over dt as an impulse: F*dt = m*dv.

functions.name: kinetic_energy
functions.body:
function Body:kinetic_energy()
  return 0.5 * self.mass * (self.vx * self.vx
                            + self.vy * self.vy
                            + self.vz * self.vz)
end

functions.name: accelerations
functions.body:
function NBody:accelerations(bodies)
  local n = #bodies
  for i = 1, n do
    bodies[i].ax = 0
    bodies[i].ay = 0
    bodies[i].az = 0
  end

  for i = 1, n - 1 do
    for j = i + 1, n do
      local dx = bodies[j].x - bodies[i].x
      local dy = bodies[j].y - bodies[i].y
      local dz = bodies[j].z - bodies[i].z
      local d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
      if d2 < MIN_DIST then
        d2 = MIN_DIST
      end
      local dist = math.sqrt(d2)
      local inv3 = 1.0 / (dist * d2)
      local fi = G * bodies[j].mass * inv3
      local fj = G * bodies[i].mass * inv3
      bodies[i].ax = bodies[i].ax + fi * dx
      bodies[i].ay = bodies[i].ay + fi * dy
      bodies[i].az = bodies[i].az + fi * dz
      bodies[j].ax = bodies[j].ax - fj * dx
      bodies[j].ay = bodies[j].ay - fj * dy
      bodies[j].az = bodies[j].az - fj * dz
    end
  end

  return bodies
end
functions.developer_comment:
- Accumulates the pairwise gravitational acceleration of every body.
- Uses a softened distance to avoid singularities at close range.

functions.name: step
functions.body:
function NBody:step(bodies, dt)
  for i = 1, #bodies do
    local b = bodies[i]
    b.vx = b.vx + b.ax * dt
    b.vy = b.vy + b.ay * dt
    b.vz = b.vz + b.az * dt
  end

  for i = 1, #bodies do
    local b = bodies[i]
    b.x = b.x + b.vx * dt
    b.y = b.y + b.vy * dt
    b.z = b.z + b.vz * dt
  end
end
functions.developer_comment: Semi-implicit Euler step: velocities from accelerations, then positions.

functions.name: total_energy
functions.body:
function NBody:total_energy(bodies)
  local e = 0
  for i = 1, #bodies do
    e = e + bodies[i]:kinetic_energy()
  end

  for i = 1, #bodies - 1 do
    for j = i + 1, #bodies do
      local d = vec3.length(vec3.sub(
        { bodies[j].x, bodies[j].y, bodies[j].z },
        { bodies[i].x, bodies[i].y, bodies[i].z }))
      e = e - G * bodies[i].mass * bodies[j].mass / d
    end
  end

  return e
end
functions.developer_comment: Total mechanical energy: kinetic plus pairwise potential.

functions.name: dot
length
functions.body:
function V.length(v)
  local d = math.sqrt(V.dot(v, v))
  if d < EPS then
    return EPS
  end
  return d
end
functions.developer_comment: Euclidean length, guarded against sub-epsilon results.

functions.name: normalize
functions.body:
function V.normalize(v)
  local d = V.length(v)
  if d <= EPS then
    return ZERO
  end
  return V.scale(v, 1 / d)
end
functions.developer_comment: Unit vector in the direction of v; the zero vector maps to ZERO.
